turns.replyText:
Hello there,

Thanks so much for reaching out to us!

We totally understand that sometimes plans change, however, once an order is placed, we’re unable to cancel, modify, refund, return, or exchange it due to how quickly our system begins processing. 💻✨

That said, if you just placed your order, you’ve got a 30-minute window to update your shipping address yourself! Just head over to your order dashboard here:

🔗 https://account.evryjewels.com/orders/

After that window, we’re unable to make changes, as outlined in our https://evry-jewels.gorgias.help/en-US/refund-policy-387780, located within the 'Help' section accessible at the bottom of our website or during the checkout process.

We also want to reassure you that all purchases go through Shopify’s secure, encrypted checkout. If you used Shop Pay or Apple Pay, the process might’ve felt super quick but rest assured, it was still a fully authorized transaction.

We truly appreciate your understanding and support. If you have any other questions, we’re always here to help. 💎

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
No, if an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed. Orders can’t be modified once placed.

The only limited exception is correcting the shipping address within 30 minutes of purchase. That window does not allow cancellations or item changes.

If you’d like a specialist to review a specific order, please share the email address used at checkout.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
Orders are final sale, so cancellations aren’t available after an order is placed. Because a cancellation cannot be processed, there isn’t a refund timeline for a cancelled order.

The only 30-minute window is for updating the shipping address, not cancelling the order. If you’re asking about a specific order, please share the email address used at checkout.
